title: Kozy Heat Bayport Direct Vent Gas Fireplace Installation
description: This beautifully designed room is ready for Fall weather! We supplied & installed this Kozy Heat Bayport 41” Gas Fireplace for the 2021 Hamptons Designer Show House. This fireplace is available in a visually appealing traditional log set or glass media style. Direct vent gas fireplaces don't require a chimney or existing fireplace for installation – they can be fitted almost anywhere, including on interior walls & in modern homes. Contact us to upgrade your room
